X. COORDINATION WITH OTHERS
1. Public Meetings
Public meetings on the proposed project have been held throughout the application stage (see Part IV, Decision Making Process). The latest public hearing was held on June 11, 1973.
2. Development of Impact Statement
The following individuals and/or agencies were contacted during the preparation of this statement.
a. City Government:
Mayor's office, James McDonald, Adm. Assistant to Mayor.
Dept. of Public Works, Cork Paffenburger, Director.
Bureau of City Planning, William C. Faust, Director of Planning.
Housing Inspection Service, George C. Collison, Chief Housing Inspector.
Redevelopment Authority of Harrisburg, General Staff.
b. Tri-County Regional Planning Commission, George S. Jennings, Associate Director.
c. Pennsylvania Historical Society, William Penn Museum, William Watson.
d. Pennsylvania Department of Transportation, Ken Force, Engineer.
e. Pennsylvania State Planning Board, George Burns, Planner.
f. Small Business Administration, Harrisburg Disaster Branch Office.
g. Pennsylvania Power and Light Company, Clarence C. Wiker, Area Manager.
h. The UGI Corporation (Local gas company).
i. Pennsylvania Department of Environmental Resources, Various Depts.
j. U. S. Department of Agriculture, Soil Conservation Service, Sylvester C. Ekart, Soil Scientist.
